text: IBM (NYSE: IBM) discloses its major shareholders in its own proxy statement: as of December 31, 2025 they are The Vanguard Group (10.03%), BlackRock Inc. (8.3%) and State Street Corporation (6.03%); no state or sovereign-fund holder is listed among them.

source.name: IBM, 2026 Notice of Annual Meeting & Proxy Statement (DEF 14A)
source.quote: information as to any person known to IBM to be the beneficial owner of more than five percent of IBM's common stock as of December 31, 2025
